intent: The shared anchored-overlay boundary on Radix Popover: it captures the launch rect before mounting, then portals a positioned, edge-aware, optionally draggable/resizable surface. Modal by default; defaults to 240px wide, side="left".
guidance: The low-level boundary that inspector dialogs and mini-players build on — it renders no header, title, or close, so put those in `children`. Modal by default (`trapFocus`); pass `trapFocus={false}` with `preserveFocusOnOpen` for passive chrome that must not grab focus. Anchor with a `trigger`, or omit it and pass `anchorSelector` for a free-floating surface with no launcher. Use `anchorSurfaceSelector` to dock the side axis to the inspector's left edge clear of the trigger's x (#499); `dragHandleSelector` lets a descendant drag the window; `resizable` adds the bottom-right handle. `surface="bare"` drops the panel chrome; `boundarySelector` names the collision host. `ariaLabel` is required.

anatomy.description: Optional launch control wrapped in an inline-flex host; its rect is captured before the portal mounts so a controlled open never flashes at viewport origin. Omitted in free-floating mode (anchorSelector).

The portalled, positioned Popover content. With surface="default": rounded-c-lg, bg-c-bg, shadow-c-500. Edge-aware (avoidCollisions, sticky) and drag-clamped to the overlay boundary; surface="bare" keeps positioning without the panel chrome.
The host-supplied children — header, title, close, and body all live here; this component renders none of them itself.
Optional bottom-right nwse affordance (a 20px <button> with an 8px corner glyph), shown only when `resizable` is set; drag- and arrow-key-resizable, clamped to product limits and the boundary.

use_when: Building a floating inspector surface that must anchor to a trigger (or named element) and stay clipped to the overlay host.
A composa overlay that needs edge-aware placement with no viewport-origin flash, optionally draggable/resizable.
dont_use_when: You want a ready-made titled dialog with header bar and close X — use InspectorDialog (which composes this).
A blocking task or confirmation — use Modal.
A simple option list — use Menu / Dropdown.

slots.trigger: Optional launch control captured for anchoring; omit and pass anchorSelector for a free-floating surface with no persistent launcher.
slots.children: The overlay contents (header/title/close/body); this component wraps them but renders none of them.

tokens.elevation: opt-in via `elevation` prop: var(--elevation-400) | var(--elevation-500) applied inline as box-shadow.
tokens.note: Default width (240px), sideOffset/collisionPadding (8px), z-index (z-50), max-width guard (calc(100vw-16px)), and the resize affordance dimensions (20px hit area, 8px glyph, 4px inset) are hardcoded layout values, not spacing tokens. No hardcoded colors — every color binds to a c-* token or an --elevation-* var.

a11y.role: dialog — the portalled surface literally renders role="dialog" with aria-label; aria-modal follows `trapFocus` (modal focus trap by default).
a11y.label: ariaLabel is required and names the overlay (there is no title-element association).
a11y.focus: Modal by default: traps focus and returns it to the captured trigger on close (onCloseAutoFocus). preserveFocusOnOpen keeps focus on the opener for passive chrome. Escape closes via onClose.
a11y.resize: The optional resize handle is a <button> (aria-label "Resize floating dialog") operable with arrow keys.

code.example:
<AnchoredInspectorOverlay open={open} onClose={close} ariaLabel="Type settings" trigger={<IconButton icon={Type} />}>
  {/* header / body */}
</AnchoredInspectorOverlay>
